full_sentence: Ana asked me where I had put my keys.
acceptable_variants: I had left my keys at home.
I had kept my keys in my bag.

options.why_wrong: Reported questions keep the normal word order of a statement: subject before verb. There is no auxiliary inversion as in direct questions.
After a past reporting verb such as 'asked', the tense usually moves back one step, so 'put' should become 'had put'.
Inversion belongs to direct questions. In reported speech the word order returns to statement form.

grammar_focus: Reported questions and backshifting of tenses
explanation: A reported question uses statement word order and moves the tense back one step after a past reporting verb. Here the past simple in the direct question becomes the past perfect.
translation: Ana zapytała mnie, gdzie położyłam klucze.
